outcome: Arterial blood gas tensions (partial pressure of arterial carbon dioxide, partial pressure of arterial oxygen)
cohort: Sixteen lamb fetuses with surgically induced diaphragmatic hernia were divided into two groups receiving either sildenafil or saline infusion antenatally, with 12 lambs ultimately included in the analysis.
finding: Sustained maternal antenatal sildenafil infusion reduced pulmonary arterial pressure and increased pulmonary blood flow in DH lambs for the first 120 minutes after birth, indicating improved pulmonary vascular function.
gest_age: Surgical induction of DH at ~80 days' gestation; treatment from 105 days' gestation; delivery at ~138 days' gestation (term is ~147 days)
